notes.title: Introducing Wu Yun & The Eye of the Serpent
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome back, Sea Rats![/h2]

Previously, we showcased the four heroes you’ll be playing as throughout your [i][b]Curse of the Sea Rats[/b][/i] adventure: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1453900/view/3189122178171113907][b]David Douglas[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1453900/view/4766508662079354328][b]Buffalo Calf[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1453900/view/3323106153058340565][b]Bussa[/b][/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1453900/view/3354631985724731446][b]Akane Yamakawa[/b][/url]. Today, we’ll be introducing [b]Wu Yun[/b], a key figure who you’ll frequently encounter as you continue to explore the rugged Irish coast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/31f2249f11a0ba88b0572ed4303f138034c9fa31.png[/img]

This mysterious apparition first appears before your eyes on [b]Shipwreck Beach[/b] after your party receives an [b]Ancient Amulet[/b] from [b]Admiral Benjamin Blacksmith[/b]. The very same amulet that was used in the spell by [b]Flora Burn[/b] to turn the entire crew into anthropomorphic rats.

[h3]Shen of the Southern Sea[/h3]

Wu Yun is an [b]emissary of the Shen[/b], an ancient order that serves the master of the [i][b]Eye of the Serpent[/b][/i]. In exchange for incredible power, the master of the Eye must pay a fair price in return…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/e997786df2f927767215e354335d0a447e524da5.jpg[/img]

Passed down from master to master over centuries, forcibly or otherwise, the Eye of the Serpent consists of two items, [b]a powerful ring[/b], and [b]the amulet that you currently hold[/b]. 

Unfortunately, the ring has been stolen by the villainous Flora Burn and her new-found abilities are growing stronger by the minute!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/1b562271770ecfdc2347ad19c119d638119eebf6.jpg[/img]

Wu Yun dutifully requests your assistance in reclaiming the ring from Flora and helping to enact the price she should have paid for using its incredible power.

[h3]A Fair Price Indeed[/h3]

You’ll be able to find Wu Yun at various fixed points on the map, and each interaction with him will save your progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/140730934520116f95a504ae79387d9129252baf.gif[/img]

In order to defeat Flora Burn, you’ll need to harness the power of the amulet. Wu Yun perceives that the island is full of [i][b]Spiritual Energy[/b][/i] that can be harvested and brought back to him in exchange for powerful new abilities. 

Your first encounter with Wu Yun will unlock each character’s [b]Inner Element[/b]. David Douglas possesses an affinity with fire, Buffalo Calf with air, Bussa with earth, and Akane Yamakawa with water. With enough spiritual energy you’ll be able to reveal the true power of each of these elements and perform incredible feats!

Alongside the elemental magic abilities, Wu Yun will also allow you to improve your combat abilities by upgrading traits such as health, critical chance, magical attack and defence. 

Spiritual Energy can be obtained by defeating enemies and bosses, with the amount gained dependent on how challenging the adversary is. Be warned however, as [b]being defeated will cause you to lose half of your current reserve of energy[/b] and return back to the last Wu Yun location that was visited. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/bd6113546c85a4cb3d7faeac5e3d01935366593d.gif[/img]

Unless you successfully retrieve the energy that was left behind, [b]you’ll lose it all should you be defeated again![/b]

[h3]More Than Just Shen-anigans[/h3]

Not only can Wu Yun upgrade each character’s abilities and record your progress, he will also allow you to [b]freely switch between the four heroes![/b]

At any point during your Curse of the Sea Rats campaign, speak to Wu Yun to change heroes and explore each of their different playstyles and move-sets. In some instances you’ll find that [b]certain characters are more suited for a particular situation[/b] so its always worth switching things up every now and then!

Each character has their own [b]unique skill tree[/b] so any spiritual energy that has been used to progress through that tree will not carry over onto the others. Fortunately, any unspent spiritual energy that you have collected can be used by any character!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/ff04b38d0ea79e46583fb5b472f7be03732e7018.png[/img]

It’s up to you to decide whether to upgrade your party equally or pick a favourite or two to level up first. 

In [b]co-op mode you’ll have a combined pool of spiritual energy[/b], so you’ll need to decide as a team how this energy is spent. Will you focus on growing one character at a time or upgrade your entire party equally? 

[h3]Thinking With Portals[/h3]

Being in possession of the amulet, you can make use of the [b]Ancestral Gateways[/b] that are located at various points on the map. These gateways appear in each of the main named locations that you’ll be discovering and can be used to [b]travel between distant points in an instant![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/9e687d3d5a6e57738fb51fde3498983d5db1951a.jpg[/img]

However, this does come at a price, as [b]you’ll need to open gateways with spiritual energy[/b] before you can use them. Fortunately, once opened these gates will never close and can be used at your convenience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/585abfad623c89f4ab934eca4eb6cc999bf29cf0.jpg[/img]

That’s all for today but stay tuned for future updates where we’ll be exploring more of the world and characters in Curse of the Sea Rats!

notes.title: Character Spotlight: Akane Yamakawa
notes.content:
Today we’ll be wrapping up our series of [b]character spotlights[/b] by introducing [b]Akane Yamakawa[/b], the final member of the cursed crew who’ll be joining [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1453900/view/3189122178171113907][b]David Douglas[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1453900/view/4766508662079354328]Buffalo Calf[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1453900/view/3323106153058340565][b]Bussa[/b][/url] on their quest to save the Admiral’s son and regain their freedom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/58cbcb2e43be4e908916ed80271a77dc4614c682.png[/img]

Akane Yamakawa is a [b]Japanese Onna-bugeisha[/b], a trained warrior of the Shogun who was captured whilst on a secret mission in America. Although very little is known about her mysterious past, her skill at wielding her [b]deadly naginata[/b] is without question.  

[h3]Sting Like a Bee[/h3]

Of all of the crew, Akane Yamakawa possesses the close combat [b]weapon with the longest reach[/b] and as such, excels at [b]mid to long range combat[/b]. Her naginata can land hits from a far greater distance than David Douglas’s cutlass, and is invaluable at keeping enemies at bay before they can get close enough to strike. 

As a warrior of the Shogun, she has complete mastery over her weapon and is capable of many impressive and [b]acrobatic feats[/b]. Attacking while jumping high in the air allows her to sweep her blade around or [b]bring it straight down[/b] on the enemy from above. Her combination attack demonstrates her prowess with [b]two fast sweeping strikes followed by a flurry of precise stabs[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/7cbcdcbd4b97aaa6c64d635bf4bd652ead4641a0.gif[/img]

If she attacks while rushing towards an opponent, Akane will perform a slight running leap, [b]thrusting her naginata forward for maximum reach[/b].

[h3]Be Like Water[/h3]

As the most poised and graceful of the crew, Akane Yamakawa naturally gained a special [b]affinity for water[/b] when imbued with the magics of the amulet. One of her first abilities, [b]Water Charge[/b], surrounds Akane in water as she lunges forward, dealing damage to any enemy caught in her path. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/4f8fedb91147c95d3cab482d195af5d488ee4607.gif[/img]

Persistent enemies may manage to charge past Akane’s whirling naginata, and in these instances, she can use her [b]Water Shield[/b]. This ability envelops her in a pool of water that deals damage to anyone unfortunate enough to get too close. Water Shield can be improved using the [b]Ice Breaker[/b] upgrade that reduces incoming damage even further.

For prolonged battles and long journeys into unknown territory, the [b]Water Fall[/b] ability will allow Akane to passively regenerate her energy. 

And finally, with her ultimate art, [b]Tsunami[/b], she can call forth a terrifying tidal wave to come crashing down around her that deals magical damage to all enemies. 

That concludes our look at the cutthroat crew of Curse of the Sea Rats! Who will you be choosing?

notes.title: Character Spotlight: Bussa
notes.content:
[h2]Ahoy there, buccaneers![/h2]
 
So far, we have showcased two of the swashbuckling heroes you’ll be playing as in [i][b]Curse of the Sea Rats[/b][/i]; the cunning swordsman [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1453900/view/3189122178171113907][b]David Douglas[/b][/url] and fierce Cheyenne hunter [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1453900/view/4766508662079354328][b]Buffalo Calf[/b][/url]. Today we’ll be taking a look at the third member of the cursed crew, [b]Bussa![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/d46d6fb03e0f23493881917338d58dc918294472.png[/img]

Hailing from the island of Barbados, [b]Bussa[/b] is a fugitive slave that managed to escape his oppressors to become a leader of a group of rebels fighting against slavery. He vows to break free from the Imperial chains once more as he joins [b]David Douglas[/b] and [b]Buffalo Calf[/b] in their mission to [b]track down the Admiral’s son[/b] and [b]defeat Flora Burn.[/b]

[h3]Brawn Over Beauty[/h3]

Bussa is a dab hand when it comes to using, well, his hands. [b]There is no finer brawler out there[/b], and his hand-to-hand combat skills make Bussa a serious force to be reckoned with. [b]Despite being slower than Buffalo Calf[/b], Bussa is equally as [b]deadly at close range[/b], unleashing a flurry of hard-hitting punches culminating in a [b]vicious uppercut[/b].

As the largest of the Sea Rats. Bussa can [b]use his size to his advantage[/b]. Attacking while jumping will result in Bussa leveraging his full weight to come crashing down on the enemy with a [b]bone-breaking bellyflop[/b], flattening anyone unfortunate enough to be caught beneath him!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/a0c4d51289ec8bdd37d715f87e780d183b3666de.gif[/img]

Bussa also possesses the [b]unique ability to be able to block attacks[/b] in place of the parry technique that the other characters utilize. Holding the technique button/key will allow Bussa to hunker down and [b]deflect all incoming damage[/b], making him perfect for a defensive playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/5421bf90917e12d8a02ec853007bceba6d743a65.gif[/img]

[h3]I Predict an Earthquake[/h3]

Thanks to the powers imbued by the talisman, Bussa’s strength can be greatly increased to a ground-shattering level. His new [b]Earth magic[/b] and related abilities include unleashing a[b] devastating Earthquake[/b] that sends a shockwave forward, harming everything in its path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/e551d4622857891974503fee6913a15e0d045e7f.gif[/img]

Another technique, [b]Heavy Drill[/b], causes Bussa to spin rapidly on the spot, arms extended, turning him into a raging tornado of fists. Any enemy caught nearby will be trapped in this rapid onslaught of attacks

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/dd54c1b43b3d6fedbc04b25cfde8b159b96f82a7.jpg[/img]
 
Eventually, Bussa will be able to bolster his attack combo with [b]Granite Hit[/b]. This powerful punch lands at the end of his combo and will [b]break an enemy’s armour[/b].  If earth-sundering, armour-shattering combos weren’t enough, Bussa’s ultimate technique, [b]Rock Rain[/b], will cause a [b]hail of boulders[/b] to come crashing down from the sky. Using his immense strength, Bussa repeatedly strikes the ground causing debris to fill the screen and damage all enemies in range!

Next time we’ll be introducing the final member of the cursed crew, the graceful yet deadly Onna-bugeisha, [b]Akane Yamakawa![/b]

In the meantime why not join our [b]Discord[/b] and tell us who you’re most looking forward to playing as!

See you soon!

Petoons Studio

notes.title: Character Spotlight: Buffalo Calf
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome back, buccaneers![/h2]

In our last character spotlight we took a look at the skills and abilities of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1453900/view/3189122178171113907]David Douglas[/url], but in case you missed it, here’s a quick recap on the story so far in [i]Curse of the Sea Rats[/i]!

The year is 1777, and you are imprisoned aboard the [b]HMS Barfleur[/b] on its journey back from America to England where you will face trial. In the ship’s brig is a vicious crew of pirates and their notorious Captain, [b]Flora Burn[/b], who rumour has it, possesses a mysterious magical talisman. One stormy night, Flora seizes the chance to escape by casting a powerful spell which transforms everyone on board into rats! She frees the rest of her crew and [b]kidnaps the Admiral's son[/b] in the process.

Having run aground along the rugged Irish Coast, the Barfleur’s crew and remaining prisoners make their way to shore. Here the Admiral begs you to bring back his son in exchange for a full pardon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/857b961207cad570ebfe588a6fbf40e14c266c4a.png[/img]

Accompanying [b]David Douglas[/b] in his mission is the fierce Cheyenne hunter, [b]Buffalo Calf[/b], who was captured and thrown into chains for sneaking into a British encampment and releasing the horses while the soldiers slept.

[h3]Flying Daggers[/h3]

Buffalo Calf’s weapon of choice is the humble [b]dagger[/b], of which she owns many! At close range Buffalo Calf is a [b]lightning fast combatant[/b], wielding two daggers with great speed and proficiency. To compensate for her lack of reach at mid-range, she also possesses the unique ability to be able to [b]throw her weapons[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/46de452cd1985aa3d450c4ef2039d44c1c33976a.gif[/img]

Whether crouching low to the ground or jumping in the air, Buffalo Calf can utilise her daggers to perform [b]ranged attacks[/b]. From a crouched position she can project a blade in a straight line forwards, catching enemies that lie within its path. Attacking while jumping will allow her to launch three small daggers in a downward arc, covering a large area in a deft fanning motion. These airborne daggers can be fired upwards, downwards, or straight ahead using the directional buttons/keys.

[h3]Unleash the Thunderbird[/h3]

Progressing through Buffalo Calf's skill tree will unlock a variety of long-range attacks. One of her very first abilities, [b]Knife Throw[/b], sends two magical knives dead ahead to deal some serious magical damage! This skill can be buffed with [b]Lightning Knives[/b], adding bonus [b]shock damage[/b] to enemies for 5 seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/53a2320ec749b181063f2632035d7ba9e00daef6.gif[/img]

If that wasn't enough, Buffalo Calf can also launch [b]Piercing Storm[/b], raining a shower of deadly knives down from above. 

With enough [b]spiritual energy[/b] she will eventually be able to swap her knives out for much stronger and deadlier [b]Tomahawks[/b] and call upon the mighty [b]Thunderbird[/b] to jump in any direction and deal magical damage to all enemies in her way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/b2755cbe2907ebd26955377a2c3ce9070b25d7d0.jpg[/img]

Keep an eye for our next post where we’ll be shining the spotlight on the musclebound brawler from Barbados, [b]Bussa[/b]!

Join our [b]Discord[/b] and let us know who you'll be choosing in your fight against the dreaded [b]Captain Flora Burn.[/b]

[url=https://discord.com/channels/707335419167113217/956597128090750996][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/7546763a75a38c09ff4c709bc05e0f68fa296629.png[/img][/url]

Until next time!

notes.title: Character Spotlight: David Douglas
notes.content:
The year is 1777, and you are a prisoner aboard the [b]HMS Barfleur[/b] on its journey from the Caribbean back to England where you will be put on trial before the court of King George. The brig is full of pirates and misfits, all bound to face the King's justice.

Unknown to the crew of the Barfleur, the Pirate Captain and Witch, [b]Flora Burn[/b] set in motion a devious plot. She cursed the Admiral and everyone on board, transforming them into rats before kidnapping the Admiral's infant son, and making her escape!

In exchange for a full pardon, the Admiral begs you and the remaining prisoners to bring back his son.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/92a8453e39b60946a3447b70d843531374490e40.png[/img]

Among those in custody is an American settler who joined the Continental Army to fight the British, [b]David Douglas[/b]. He was eventually captured and forced to board the doomed vessel...

[h3]Swashbuckling Sea Rat[/h3]

As with all Sea Rats, Douglas has a unique moveset, and can fight in a variety of different ways. As a true swashbuckler, his go-to weapon is his trusted [b]cutlass[/b]. Lethal at close and mid-range, the cutlass has good speed and reach and can be utilised effectively in most combat situations without putting Douglas at too much risk. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/a382e0e19ca651a26db763226aca1aa0cc5f2abe.gif[/img]

The cutlass is especially handy when closing the gap between any long-range fighters or for intercepting leaping enemies with its large [b]overhead sweeping attack.[/b] Douglas' jumping attacks can be a great way of catching an opponent off guard, the [b]downward mid-air slash[/b] is fast and precise making it effective against charging foes.

[h3]Fire in the Hole![/h3]

No true sailor's arsenal is complete without a [b]pistol[/b] at their side. For those enemies out of reach of the cutlass, Douglas can fire his pistol, propelling a fireball projectile in a straight line forwards. Pistol shots will deal an incredible amount of [b]fire damage[/b] to an opponent!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/b5c2c8d15b0d16f487cd97c31d847077287502fb.gif[/img]

With a natural affinity for fire, Douglas can unlock several pyro-based abilities. [b]Wild Fire[/b] is a passive ability that buffs spell damage and burns enemies for a short period of time, causing extra damage as a result. [b]Flaming Discharge[/b], is a powerful wave of fire that causes magic damage to multiple enemies caught in its blast. And finally, the [b]Blazing Tornado[/b], allows Douglas to project a huge flamethrower in front of him to deal massive amounts of magical damage to all enemies unlucky enough to be in range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/4ae5b9c933e41b92baf53f1e036b769e1b7ad4b3.png[/img]

That's all for now, but stay tuned as in our next post we'll be taking a closer look at fierce Cheyenne hunter, [b]Buffalo Calf.[/b]

Join our [b]Discord[/b] and let us know who you'll be choosing in your fight against the dreaded [b]Captain Flora Burn.[/b]

Until next time! 

Petoons Studio

notes.title: Welcome Back to the Original Rat Pack
notes.content:
[h2]Ahoy Rats, Rebels, and Renegades![/h2]

It's been some time since our last post but we're back with some big news! Firstly, we wanted to thank our community for their patience and to assure you that we have planned a regular series of developer updates that we'll be pushing out every few weeks from now until launch later this year. 

You can expect more information on dates and milestones, key game features as well as progress updates and other fun behind the scenes content!

[h3]Kickstarter Backer Demo[/h3]

A few weeks back we gave our loyal Kickstarter backers whose pledge level included 'beta access' a first exclusive look at the [b][i]Curse of the Sea Rats[/i][/b] demo. We can't thank our backers enough for supporting the project from such an early stage and hope that everyone is enjoying their time exploring the world of [b][i]Curse of the Sea Rats[/i][/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/77cba5f3adbeb3ea42cac3c2ef60ccb9cb5feb19.jpg[/img]

[h3]Backer Feedback Changes[/h3]

An important aspect of this backer demo has been gathering player feedback, and we've had a really positive response so far! We have implemented a number of key fixes in response to backer's comments and suggestions and [b]today[/b] we are releasing an updated version of the demo for backers to play. 

The change list is as follows:  

[list]
[*] Fixed issues with incompatible controllers. 
[*] Bussa blocking modified to be faster.  
[*] Fixed camera in Blacksmith intro.  
[*] Now settings presets work.  
[*] Visual improvements for the skill trees.  
[*] Fixed some chests that kept appearing in the minimap.  
[*] Other minor bug fixes. 
[/list]
To see these new changes please restart Steam and remember, this demo is only available on Steam and Windows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/5562508534a44bfa1e47d613fe5ef8c8ca47d27b.png[/img]

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]

As you know, the demo is a work-in-progress preview of the game, and content is therefore subject to change. One area the team are currently working on improving is the [b]whole cinematic system[/b] so that the player can decide when text opens. Due to the technical complexity of this particular issue, we are sorry to say that this will [b]not[/b] be implemented in the demo, but rest assured it will make its way into the finished game!  

Elsewhere, one of the main focuses has been balancing the game to make it [b]challenging, yet fair and enjoyable.[/b] All of the crew are working hard to improve the gameplay experience for the final version. The development of the game continues as planned and we expect to release the game in [b]2022[/b], all being well! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/3d4a7314bc76601e32c73469535798ad5763559f.png[/img]

[h3]How to Submit Feedback[/h3]

[b][i]The Curse of the Sea Rats[/i][/b] crew is always grateful for feedback. If you’ve played the demo and would like to share your comments and suggestions, please feel free to fill out this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSflmy_ZVNQnzbW15FC7-zY2T3Gw84W3oqXnco-UOnh9BkU4vw/viewform]feedback form[/url]. 

Alternatively, our community in [b]Discord[/b] is growing and you can join us in the specific demo channel only for backers and connect with all the pirates supporting the project. 

[url=https://discord.com/channels/707335419167113217/956597128090750996][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/7546763a75a38c09ff4c709bc05e0f68fa296629.png[/img][/url]

Remember that if your pledge level allows, you will have free access to this beta version of the game until [b]22nd April 2022[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/ecf61c00bce2325956e616681e2f4870cdec6b41.png[/img]

[h3][b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Content Creation & Embargo[/h3]

We’ve received a lot of questions about posting on social media, sharing footage and screenshots of the beta, and just have a few rules concerning this: 

[olist]
[*] There is an embargo on content sharing in effect until [b]22nd April 2022[/b]. Please do not talk about the game, share any gameplay capture, videos or screenshots before that date. 
[*] For any content that you do create, please include the disclaimer “[i]This content was captured from an early preview build of the game and is, therefore, subject to change[/i].” 
[/olist]
If any content is posted before the embargo date, we will request that it be taken down (sorry!). 

Enjoy the new version of the demo and please, report all the bugs you can find!  

Thank you very much, pirates! We'll be back with another update soon!

Petoons Studio
